items.behavior: Local stdio, classic HTTP+SSE, prompts/resources APIs, OAuth, roots, sampling, elicitation, logging control, subscriptions/tasks and automatic resource/audio/URL promotion.

Modern input_required is rejected, never reported as a successful tool result; the host starts no MRTR input flow or retry of that rejected result. The normalization fallback uses isError plus invalid-response; SDK rejection may surface UnsupportedResultType.
Calibrated semantic-rewrite policy has pure eligibility evaluation only; not connected to production rewriting. Experimental opt-in Judge is a separate implemented capability.
Pack extraction, online release/channel discovery/downloads and automatic Harness update; offline already-extracted pack installation is implemented.
Discovery consumes OpenAI-compatible models response shape; Anthropic/Gemini require exact manual model IDs and do not infer capabilities from names.
Generic adapters do not implicitly replay a partly consumed SSE stream. Responses owns its separately bounded attempt-reset/commit protocol.
No recursive delete or recursive directory copy model tool; move_directory refuses an existing destination.
Only guarded tracked mutations are rewind-safe; scratch, instruction configuration and arbitrary host processes are excluded.
Legacy candidate bundles without v2 full-manifest authority, missing anchors and unsupported file kinds remain explicit degradation/untracked outcomes. No candidate garbage collection.
Automatic inherited parent Skill activation for child Agents remains deferred.
Optional registry/marketplace beyond supported local/Git repository installation remains deferred.
Dedicated automatic restore command and per-turn instruction-change audit records remain deferred; current .previous and init backups permit manual recovery.
PrefixShape hashing and CacheDiagnostics engineering remain deferred; provider usage cache reporting is implemented.
Eight npm native variants are declared; current S0 CI proves Linux x64 and Windows x64 only. Other variants remain in the denominator pending native consumers.
Runtime en/zh-CN localization is an explicit proposed addition, not an existing TS capability.

rule: An implemented limitation or failure behavior is preserved as an observable contract; not-implemented/deferred items are excluded only from the existing TS capability denominator, not silently removed from an accepted future addition.
